stories.title: Dolly Parton dead at 80
new_facts: Film editor recounts Parton's energy on set of a 2022 Christmas movie, a new eyewitness account.
New angle: Parton's love of the Great Smoky Mountains helped transform her Tennessee hometown economically.
New on-record quote from Miley Cyrus: 'I will always love her.'
Dollywood theme park president states plans are in place to honor Parton's legacy.
New details: hair loss, six-month reclusive final period, goddaughter Miley Cyrus' reaction.
New figure: Parton wrote over 3,000 songs; also cites her LGBTQ+ rights and women's empowerment advocacy.
Reveals a painful health condition and radical treatment that prevented Parton from having children.
Retrospective on Parton's 9 to 5 film debut calling her a 'natural-born movie star.'
Fuller Miley Cyrus quote: 'I will always love her and want to make her proud.'

stories.line: Dolly Parton, country music icon and philanthropist, has died at 80.

stories.title: Meta settles youth addiction lawsuits for $17B despite weak age verification technology
new_facts: Raises specific concern that settlement's age-verification technology is unreliable and privacy-risky.
New total figure of $18 billion cited for settlement with 48 states.
Names California specifically among settling states.
Cites child-safety groups and former Meta employees critiquing settlement as insufficient.
Specifies new safety measure: blocks on nighttime app use for teens, total up to $18bn.
Florida rejects the $18B deal, calling it 'peanuts,' declining to join settlement.
Adds specific measure: daily time limits for child Instagram users; cites 29 states as plaintiffs.
stories.line: Meta settles state lawsuits over social media harms to minors for up to $17.1 billion, but the settlement relies on age verification technology that doesn't reliably work.

stories.title: FDA approves pancreatic cancer drug that nearly doubled survival in trials
new_facts: FDA approved Revolution Medicines' pancreatic cancer drug; disease kills seven of eight patients within five years.
Names drug Rasonque; trial showed median survival of 13 months, nearly double chemo alone.
Drug targets RAS protein driving 95% of pancreatic adenocarcinoma cases; used after chemo fails.
Reveals the drug's generic name, daraxonrasib.
Notes FDA gave expedited approval; drug blocks mutation fueling growth in over 90% of cases.
stories.line: FDA approved daraxonrasib for pancreatic cancer after trials showed it nearly doubled patient survival rates.

stories.title: Anthropic commits $45 billion to AI compute rental deal with Nscale
new_facts: AWS to add 2M more Nvidia Blackwell Ultra/Rubin/Rubin Ultra GPUs in 2027-2028, beyond March's 1M order

OpenAI built its chip in record time using its own AI models to speed design and verification

stories.line: Anthropic commits $45 billion over six years to rent AI computing power from a UK startup, cementing the industry's dependence on massive infrastructure spending.

British embassy joint statement (with Australia, EU, Finland, France, Norway, Switzerland) on floods; 12 Britons missing.
Americans confirmed among the nearly 400 missing tourists.

Survivors describe homes being swept away by landslide.
David Fisher, head of International Red Cross delegation in Nepal, involved in rescue effort commentary.
Nearly 50 Americans among hundreds missing in China-Nepal border floods.
34 Australians reported missing among flood victims.

stories.line: Flash floods and mudslides in Nepal have killed at least 150 people with hundreds still missing, including dozens of Americans and Australians.

stories.title: FBI seizes botnet used in Chinese hacks of NASA, DOJ, Fed
new_facts: FBI reveals Chinese hackers disguised traffic to breach Fed, Senate, NASA and other bodies.
US seized two domains used since 2018 to target sensitive government networks.

FBI disrupted the proxy tools/infrastructure used by hackers, per DOJ.
stories.line: U.S. agencies including NASA, DOJ, and Federal Reserve were compromised by Chinese state-sponsored hackers using a botnet the FBI has now seized.
